visual.description: Pure black used as the primary page background across all sections.
White used for all hero and section headings in bold uppercase typography.
Light gray used for body copy and descriptive paragraph text on dark backgrounds.
Very dark near-black used as a slightly elevated surface background in sections.
Dark gray used for button borders and subtle UI element outlines.
White-bordered button with white text used as the primary CTA button style.
Muted light gray used for navigation links and footer text items.
Warm rusty orange dominant color of the Mars hero image filling the first section.
Muted teal-blue dominant color of the launch pad aerial section background image.
Dark slate blue-gray dominant tone in the rocket landing section background.
